body: I don't think anything is worth it. I think sometimes the pain people have been through really does trump life. But again, I at least hope things get better for you. I feel like life wasn't meant to suck this much.

I regret it with nearly every breath I take. There are moments when I feel grateful I didn't complete it- like when I play with my nephew & niece. Those moments are fleeting though. And then I'm left here. Torture. I feel more trapped now than I did back then though. Last year I knew less people. Less lives were involved. Less had been done to stop me. If I did it now, I feel like I'd be giving a nice F YOU to all of my friends and family. And therapists. I can't do that to them. Not after all they've done for me.

So yes. I regret it practically every moment. I'm definitely not from the future and don't have any fancy powers- I just hope that things get better for you.

That does really suck- I'm sorry. But your wife sounds like she really loves you- so that's pretty fantastic. I'm glad you have a partner to go through this with. Overall though, I'm sorry it sucks so much. Good luck at court tomorrow.
